full_qualification.pending_requirements_verbatim: Build the base from a worktree at the starting head and the candidate from the final head, both with 'GOAMD64=v3 go build -trimpath -o build/sp-X ./cmd/speedprobe', then run 'nice -n 10 python3 scripts/speedcheck.py build/sp-base build/sp-new --net engine/nets/ngn-h512-81215229.nnue --cpu 3 --depth 12 --duration 10 --repeats 8 --out evidence/speed.json'. Identity in evidence/speed.json must be equal for both backends (exact nodes, scores and moves): a difference means the change altered play, and the branch then carries no engine change. KEEP needs a mean of repeat_gain_pct at or above +1.0 for the nnue backend with at least 7 of 8 repeats positive; otherwise SHELVED, with the patch kept as evidence/candidate.patch and no engine change on the branch. Either is a complete result; no tuning retries. final.md gives the gain and the profile share before and after. Registered gates pass.
